newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens lower on Dow, limited sell pressure.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens lower on Dow, limited sell pressure.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started Thursday's session weaker, depressed by big Wall Street losses following the London market close, dealers said.
London losses were limited however by a lack of concerted selling pressure and trading was set to continue quiet, they said.
"There's precious little selling and the buyers come and go," said one.
"Most of this is down to the futures," he said.
By 0744 GMT the FTSE was 12.5 points off at 4,279.8. The June futures were 15 points off at 4,288. Fair value is around 10 points.
